surveys.title: Before we go any further
questions: Do you have enough time to start or work on your business? Really? What factors help or hinder you right now?

surveys.title: Business readiness check-in
questions: I've created a product or refined a service. (yes/no)
I spend more than eight hours a week on my business. (yes/no)
I've spent money on my business. (yes/no)
My friends and family know that I've started a business. (yes/no)
I have filed for incorporation with the state and received an EIN and applicable licensure. (yes/no)
My business at least partially supports me. (yes/no)
My business employs people or compensates contractors. (yes/no)
My business has a physical location outside my home. (yes/no)

surveys.title: Time management reflection
questions: Do you really have enough time to start or work on your business? What current time-consuming things do you think may present problems with time management?

surveys.title: Branding Roundup
questions: List a few examples of your favorite or least favorite brands and think about why you love them or loathe them.
Write about how you found out about them, what you think they stand for, and how you fit into their customer profile.
